answer: Vouching bonds: a new agent only earns rewards once an established peer locks stake to sponsor it, and that bond is slashed if the newcomer is later proven a sybil. Honest agents find this a safe haven, sipping the nectar of rewards after one cheap vouch. An attacker needs a separate bonded voucher per fake identity, so locked capital and slashing risk grow linearly with every clone, and reputation built on basalt-solid sponsorship cannot be faked in bulk.
